name: Navier-Stokes-inspired liquidity concentration feasibility v1
scientific_claim: Local concentration of signed aggressive flow contains incremental information about a subsequent five-minute opening price excursion beyond conventional top-of-book state and activity measures.

scope.sampling: one-second causal BBO snapshots using ts_recv

primary_outcome: maximum absolute midpoint excursion in basis points from the first outcome-window midpoint
event_definition: at or above the training-period 90th percentile; the threshold is frozen from training data and applied unchanged to the next calendar year
candidate_family: L-infinity/L2, L4/L2, and L8/L2 signed-flow-velocity norm ratios
temporal flow shear and enstrophy proxies
maximum displacement per normalized gross flow
model: class-weighted L2 logistic regression with C=0.25; median imputation and standardization fit on training only
success_gate: positive augmented-minus-baseline average precision in both temporal folds and a pooled improvement of at least 0.02; confirmation still requires date-cluster bootstrap uncertainty and an independent full-depth dataset
kill_gate: no material out-of-sample improvement, unstable sign across folds, or improvement attributable only to one symbol/year
non_claims: The Reynolds proxy is a physical Reynolds number
MBP-1 can measure spatial liquidity gradients or full-depth core width
A feasibility result authorizes paper or live trading
